crm_inbound_enquiries.ddl:
CREATE TABLE crm_inbound_enquiries (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	organization_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	contact_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_import_id INTEGER, 
	created_by_user_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	assigned_user_id VARCHAR, 
	record_kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	intent VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	campaign VARCHAR, 
	source_lead_id VARCHAR, 
	source_sheet VARCHAR, 
	source_row_number INTEGER, 
	enquiry_date TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	criteria JSON NOT NULL, 
	strict_fields JSON NOT NULL, 
	raw_notes TEXT, 
	observed_data JSON NOT NULL, 
	inferred_data JSON NOT NULL, 
	confirmed_data JSON NOT NULL, 
	qualification JSON NOT NULL, 
	extraction_confidence FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	extraction_evidence JSON NOT NULL, 
	review_reasons JSON NOT NULL, 
	next_follow_up DATE, 
	first_response_due_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	first_contact_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	last_contact_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	contact_attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	lost_reason VARCHAR, 
	tags JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(contact_id) REFERENCES crm_inbound_contacts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_import_id) REFERENCES crm_inbound_imports (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

crm_property_contact_claims.ddl:
CREATE TABLE crm_property_contact_claims (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	organization_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	import_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	list_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_sheet VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_row_number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	row_fingerprint VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	owner_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	property_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	contact_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	phone_primary VARCHAR, 
	phone_alternate VARCHAR, 
	email_primary VARCHAR, 
	area_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	project_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	building_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	unit_number VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	property_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	transaction_date DATE, 
	transaction_price_aed BIGINT, 
	party_role VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	procedure_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	ownership_status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	confidence_score INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	match_reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	lead_id VARCHAR, 
	unit_candidate_key VARCHAR, 
	latest_sale_date DATE, 
	latest_sale_price_aed BIGINT, 
	later_sale_date DATE, 
	lease_end DATE, 
	annual_rent_aed BIGINT, 
	evidence JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_crm_property_contact_claim_source_row UNIQUE (import_id, source_sheet, source_row_number), 
	FOREIGN KEY(import_id) REFERENCES crm_contact_imports (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(list_id) REFERENCES crm_contact_lists (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_crm_claim_list_owner_property_preference ON crm_property_contact_claims (organization_id, list_id, owner_key, property_key, (CASE ownership_status WHEN 'former_owner' THEN 6 WHEN 'verified_current_owner' THEN 5 WHEN 'probable_current_owner' THEN 4 WHEN 'unit_linked_unverified' THEN 3 WHEN 'conflicting_claim' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) DESC, confidence_score DESC, transaction_date DESC NULLS LAST)
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_claim_org_owner ON crm_property_contact_claims (organization_id, owner_key)
CREATE INDEX ix_crm_claim_org_owner_property ON crm_property_contact_claims (organization_id, owner_key, property_key)

CREATE INDEX ix_crm_claim_owner_property_preference ON crm_property_contact_claims (organization_id, owner_key, property_key, (CASE ownership_status WHEN 'former_owner' THEN 6 WHEN 'verified_current_owner' THEN 5 WHEN 'probable_current_owner' THEN 4 WHEN 'unit_linked_unverified' THEN 3 WHEN 'conflicting_claim' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) DESC, confidence_score DESC, transaction_date DESC NULLS LAST)
